message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth", "construction": "Percentage change in total assets (Compustat ATQ) over the most recent fiscal quarter.", "rationale": "Rapid asset growth may indicate empire building or overinvestment, potentially leading to lower future returns due to inefficient capital deployment.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Operating Expense Ratio", "construction": "Total operating expenses (Compustat XOPR) divided by total revenues (Compustat REVT) from the latest annual report.", "rationale": "Firms with higher operating efficiency may generate better margins and be more competitively positioned, leading to superior returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "Cumulative R&D expenditures (Compustat XRD) over past 3 years divided by total assets (Compustat AT) at the latest fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Firms investing more in R&D may be positioned for innovation-driven growth and higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Change in inventory turnover ratio (annual cost of goods sold (COGS, Compustat COGS) divided by average inventories (Compustat INVT)) over the past two years.", "rationale": "Improving inventory management may indicate operational improvements and demand strength.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Insider Buying", "construction": "Net shares bought by insiders over the past 6 months, from SEC Form 4 filings, scaled by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Executives with superior information may buy stock ahead of positive developments, signaling undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Capex Deviation", "construction": "Current year's capital expenditures (Compustat CAPX) minus average of previous three years' CAPX, scaled by total assets (Compustat AT).", "rationale": "Sudden increases or decreases in investment may signal strategic shifts; negative deviations could reflect caution or underinvestment, while positive may reflect over-optimism.", "higher_returns_for": "moderate or near-zero values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Indicator", "construction": "Dummy variable: 1 if a company paid dividends last year, but omitted dividends this year; 0 otherwise (Compustat DV/annual reports).", "rationale": "Dividend omission often signals financial distress, which may lead to higher required returns as compensation for risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure (i.e., recent dividend omissions)"}, {"name": "Late 10-K Filing Flag", "construction": "Dummy variable: 1 if the company files its annual 10-K report later than the SEC deadline; 0 otherwise (public SEC EDGAR data).", "rationale": "Late filings may signal accounting or operational issues, which could increase risk and expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure (i.e., late filers)"}, {"name": "Earnings Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly earnings per share (EPS, Compustat EPSPX) over the last eight quarters.", "rationale": "Higher earnings volatility may indicate business risk, leading to higher required compensation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Analyst Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of one-year-ahead EPS forecasts across analysts (I/B/E/S) at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Greater disagreement among analysts may signal higher uncertainty and risk, potentially leading to higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
